items.name: Grappling Hook
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price  1 gp (common),  2,001 gp (mithral); Weight 4 lbs. (common), 2 lbs. (mithral)
DescriptionThrowing a grappling hook requires a ranged attack roll, treating the hook as a thrown weapon with a range increment of 10 feet. Objects with ample places to catch the hook have an AC of 5.

items.name: Manacles (Masterwork)
items.description:
Source Path of the Hellknight pg. 15, Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price  15 gp (common),  50 gp (masterwork),  1,000 gp (mithral); Weight 2 lbs. (common), 2 lbs. (masterwork), 2 lbs. (mithral)

items.name: Carbon Steel Curved Blade
items.description:
Compatible Proficiency: Cutlass, Scimitar, Falchion, Longsword.

 

Advanced alloy & construction process causes this blade to pierce DR as an adamantine weapon.  It's creation process is impossible with any known tech or craftsmen on Golarion.

 

This graceful, curving blade further increases the drama inherent in sword fighting.

items.name: Potion of Cure Moderate Wounds
items.description: This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 2d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10).

items.name: Rope (50 Ft.)
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 57, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 1 gp; Weight 10 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionThis 50-foot length of hemp rope has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 23 Strength check.

items.name: Wack Juce
items.description:
Refreshingly intoxicating, Wack Juce is made with the finest synthetic oranges in Numeria, and the 3rd finest potato vodka in the world: Smashka Noble!
Enjoy this sweet and soothing taste of home, you can almost hear the anthem of the Fatherland as you slurp!

items.name: Technic League Chain Shirt
items.description: Covering the torso, this shirt is made up of thousands of interlocking metal rings.
